decisionSummary: The provider factory is constructed before the persisted authorization check because the flow constructs providers in the request handler preamble.

evidence.content: instrumented counter reported provider_factory count 1 before the authorization failure gate
authorization failure was handled after provider construction started

findings.summary: provider construction precedes persisted authorization handling

failure.rootCause: the request handler constructs the provider factory in its preamble, before the persisted authorization check runs
failure.falsification: a run where the provider factory is constructed only after the authorization check passes would disprove the root cause

mustChange.change: move provider factory construction after the persisted authorization check

mustNotChange.reason: authorization store semantics are authoritative and out of scope

exactTests.name: provider_factory stays zero before authorization failure
exactTests.expectation: provider factory invocations remain zero before an authorization failure is handled
